responsibility: This machine-description fragment implements H8/300 division and remainder operations, including H8SX signed and unsigned div instructions in HI/SI modes and combined quotient/remainder patterns for QI and HI values. It maps generic div/udiv/mod/umod RTL to target instructions such as divu/divs/divxu/divxs, handles cases where quotient and remainder are produced together, and emits distinct post-reload CC-clobbering forms and remainder moves when one of the results is unused.
